title: Star-delta motor starter
goal: A reader must be able to see the three-phase star-delta power circuit and the timed, interlocked control sequence that transfers the motor from star to delta.

rubric.must: Three 400 VAC supply phases pass through a labelled 25 A three-pole breaker.
Main KM1, star KM2, and delta KM3 contactors are visibly identified.
A rated 7.5 kW three-phase motor with six U, V, and W terminals is visible.
A three-leg 9-13 A thermal overload and its 95-96 normally closed auxiliary contact are visible.
Separate START NO and STOP NC pushbuttons are visible in the control circuit.
An on-delay star-delta timer has visibly labelled NC star and NO delta changeover contacts.
Normally closed KM2 and KM3 electrical interlock contacts are visible between the star and delta coils.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Split into power and control halves, with the motor's six winding ends labelled, the delta contactor's cross-connections correct, the star contactor shorting the star point, and both coils interlocked by the opposite contactor's break contact.
